current_activity: The 708th VG Division holds the line through Raon-l'Étape to Étival-Clairefontaine facing the US 100th Division
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 22 p. 389: "The next division south, the 708th Volksgrenadiers, had just reached LXIV Corps' front"; "extended the German lines south another eight miles through Raon-l'Etape to Etival-Clairefontaine". Event definition: the situation of 10 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Raon-l'Étape with a precision of 10 km, the town the division line ran through. Location approximate: a town point on the line. Location support: CMH names Raon-l'Etape. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US VI Corps (100th Infantry Division). Context: CMH ch. 20 p. 362 says the division began moving into the line on 8 November.
